title: Yellowed Dense Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A peppery and dense Tunisian dish featuring tahini, this tagine is a cozy and sugar-free-friendly option for a cold evening, cooked to perfection in a traditional clay tajine vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, ground cumin, and ground coriander.
Heat the olive oil in the clay tajine vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the vessel and saute until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the vessel and saute for an additional minute.
Add the seasoned lamb pieces to the vessel and brown them on all sides.
Add the chicken broth and tahini to the vessel, stirring to combine.
Cover the vessel with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Cook the tagine for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
